name: apiosk
description: Find, compare, price, and run API services through Apiosk.

interface.shortDescription: Find and run the right API
interface.longDescription: Apiosk finds API services for a request, compares price and measured performance, shows the exact cost before purchase, and runs the provider the user approves. The connected Apiosk account controls balance, limits, and approval policy.
defaultPrompt: Find the best API for current company information and show me the price.
Compare APIs that can extract text from a receipt.
Plan the API calls needed to research a company before spending anything.
